addons.name: Auto-LUT
addons.description: Applies a chosen .cube LUT to new photos/videos and stacks the graded copy with the original.

addons.name: Trip Best Picks
addons.description: Selects the best photos from a trip while keeping the selection varied, and collects them in an album.

addons.name: Zine Maker
addons.description: Lays out a printable zine from a search or an album: a folded single sheet or a saddle-stitch booklet, as print-ready PDF.

addons.name: Year Highlights
addons.description: Finds the best moments across a year of video and cuts them into one film, with music and month titles.
